What does carpet installation cost in Medina, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most projects total $2,000 to $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft main level with a staircase generally comes in at $5,500 to $8,500. Wool and other premium goods price above those ranges — and the grade is your call, made with the samples lying in your own Medina rooms.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come out to Medina?

It does — Medina sits minutes off our route between the bridges. The van arrives at your scheduled time with 20+ carpet samples, wool among them, and all three pad grades. We set the samples down in the rooms being carpeted so the color reads in your own light, measure every room and stair, and leave a written price before the appointment ends. The visit costs nothing.
How much is carpet stretching in Medina?

Stretching starts at $99 per room. A power stretcher pulls the carpet taut again and removes ripples, buckles and trip spots for roughly a fifth of what replacement costs. When the pile still stands and the color still suits the room, stretching is usually the smarter spend — and we will say so.
What do carpeted stairs run in a Medina home?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step, in either a waterfall wrap or a tailored cap-and-band. Landings, curved runs and pie-shaped steps are measured and written into the quote at the appointment, so they never appear later as an extra charge.
How long does an installation take in Medina?

One day covers most Medina homes. Several bedrooms and a staircase make a routine day for the crew; a full house with multiple stairs and a lot of furniture can need a second. The schedule is written on your quote, and we keep to the day we commit to.
Will your crew handle the furniture?

Yes. On most jobs the crew moves beds, dressers, sofas and tables, then returns every piece to its place. We ask you to clear only the small and delicate items — closet floors, electronics, artwork, breakables and anything you would rather move with your own hands.
Should we stretch the carpet or replace it?

If the pile stands up, the backing is sound and you still like the carpet, a $99-per-room stretch removes the ripples and buys years of life. Replace when traffic lanes have matted flat, seams are opening, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has outlasted professional cleaning. We inspect first and tell you which case is yours before anything is quoted.
Which parts of Medina and the nearby Points do you cover?

All of them — Evergreen Point, Medina Heights, Groat Point, Dabney Point and Fairweather Bay, along with Hunts Point, Yarrow Point and Clyde Hill next door. We also work West Bellevue, Meydenbauer, Enatai and Beaux Arts Village, the rest of the Eastside, and Seattle across the bridge.
What carpet stands up best to dogs and cats?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, laid over a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier keeps accidents from soaking into the subfloor — the real source of permanent odor — and solution-dyed fiber tolerates hard cleaning, even diluted bleach, without losing color. The moisture-barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and both ride in the van.
What warranty stands behind the work?

OC Flooring backs the installation with a 1-year workmanship warranty, and the carpet carries the mill's wear and stain coverage — typically 10 to 25 years depending on grade. Both go in writing on your quote. Because your pad choice can affect the mill's coverage, all three pad grades come to the appointment so you can decide with the facts in front of you.
